statement: Every live scenario or benchmark run across all worktrees of this repository serializes through the shared machine evidence lock: two concurrent evidence-bearing runs cannot both proceed, a crashed or rebooted holder is stolen with a printed notice rather than deadlocking, and the durable capacity evidence produced under the lock is attributable to a single uncontended run.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The lock lives under the git common dir (all worktrees resolve one path) and acquisition is a single atomic mkdir; no lock path may depend on which worktree acquires.
A lock whose owner pid is dead or whose recorded worktree no longer exists is stolen with a printed notice; the mkdir-to-owner-write window is treated as LIVE and never stolen.
LAGRANGE_EVIDENCE_LOCK_BYPASS runs without the lock but prints a corruption warning into the run's own output, so bypassed evidence is attributable in any later audit.
Live runners adopt the lock via the `with -- <cmd>` wrapper or an explicit acquire/release pair when touched; this Quest does not rewrite every existing scripts/checks live runner.
Deterministic in-process tests never take the machine lock; only live/benchmark evidence-bearing runs serialize.
